title: Onboarding
description: Guide new hires through a complete digital onboarding journey including compliance checks, document signing, profile setup, and first-day planning for a smooth start.
fullDescription: ZetScore's Onboarding module handles the entire new employee welcome process in one place. It includes work authorization verification, manager-assigned documents for viewing, acknowledging, or signing, employee bio and profile picture updates, additional personal information questions to help managers understand their team better, and a customizable first-day itinerary sent directly by the manager. Everything is digital, trackable, and designed to make the transition fast and professional.
author: ZetScore Team
overview: Transform your new hire experience from paperwork chaos to a structured, digital flow that covers everything from legal compliance to personal introductions and day-one readiness.
keyBenefits: Everything in one digital platform no scattered emails or paper
Manager involvement for personalized documents, questions, and first-day plans
Quick compliance with work authorization and background checks
Better team connection through bio updates and personal info sharing
Improved new hire confidence and faster productivity
challengesSolved: We fix the usual onboarding headaches: lost documents, delayed signatures, forgotten compliance steps, generic experiences, and poor first impressions that lead to early turnover or confusion.

title: Background Checks
description: Verify candidate Education, Employment Histories, Professional Licenses etc. Doing this by reaching out to Institutions / Universities to confirm everything is accurate and legitimate.
fullDescription: Our Background Checks feature allows you to initiate and track verification of key documents. We send requests to the relevant institutions (for example, Universities / Institutions) to confirm Degrees, Certificates, Licenses, Employment History and other claimed qualifications. This ensures all information provided is genuine, helping you make confident hiring decisions while staying compliant.
author: ZetScore Team
overview: Get reliable confirmation of a candidate's educational and professional background through direct institutional verification — simple, secure, and thorough.
keyBenefits: Verification with University and Institutions for accuracy
Keeps the process organized and documented

services.title: Identity Verification
services.description: The initial stage of our screening process to confirm the true identity of a candidate. This involves scrutinizing various documents and information provided by the individual to ensure accuracy and authenticity, such as government-issued IDs, passports, social security numbers, and personal details.

services.title: Criminal Background Checks
services.description: We obtain comprehensive reports regarding any past criminal convictions, arrests, or legal issues of an individual, enabling businesses to avoid associations with individuals convicted of theft, fraud, or other dishonest behaviors.

services.title: Academic Qualification
services.description: Conducting thorough education background checks and verification for qualifications, including PHDs, Masters degrees, diplomas, certificates, and even KCSE certificates. We confirm each qualification directly with the universities and institutions concerned, so the credentials provided by employees or candidates are legitimate and accurate.

services.title: Employment History Verification
services.description: Contacting current and previous employers to verify crucial details such as dates of employment, positions held, reasons for leaving, duties, roles, responsibilities, eligibility for re-hire, and conduct gap analysis streamlining pre-employment screening and ensuring accurate and reliable background checks.

services.title: Payslip Verification
services.description: Confirm the authenticity and accuracy of an individual's payslip. This process is commonly employed by employers, financial institutions, and other organizations to verify a person's employment status, salary, and overall financial stability. It is especially important during job applications, loan approvals, and other financial transactions where proof of income is required.

services.title: Professional License Verification
services.description: Confirming the authenticity and validity of professional licenses and certifications by cross-referencing with the relevant licensing authorities and accrediting bodies.

services.title: Professional Reference Verification
services.description: Reaching out to referees enables us to get valuable insights into the candidate's or service provider's performance, character, abilities, skills, work ethics, and interpersonal skills. These references are former employers, supervisors, colleagues, or other professional contacts who can provide relevant information.

services.title: Moonlighting Check
services.description: Check whether an employee is engaged in a secondary job or business activity that could potentially conflict with their primary employment. This check helps to ensure that their employees are not working for competitors, violating non-compete agreements, or engaging in activities that could affect their performance, availability, or loyalty to the primary job.

challengesSolved: We remove the hassle and uncertainty of manual follow-ups, phone calls, fake license or educational diplomat and potential fraud by automating institutional checks with our team on the ground and providing a clear audit trail.

title: Work Authorization
description: Securely collect and verify work permits, passports, and other documents to confirm new hires are legally eligible to work.
fullDescription: With ZetScore Work Authorization, new employees upload their key documents — such as passports, work permits, visas, or other proof of eligibility — directly in the platform. The system allows HR or managers to review and verify these submissions to ensure full compliance with employment laws before onboarding proceeds. It's straightforward, secure, and keeps everything in one place.
author: ZetScore Team
overview: Make sure every new hire is legally cleared to work by handling document submission and verification digitally — fast, compliant, and stress-free.
keyBenefits: Quick review and approval by managers or HR
Ensures legal compliance from day one
Secure storage and easy access for audits
Prevents delays in starting work due to missing paperwork
challengesSolved: We eliminate the back-and-forth of emailing sensitive documents, lost files, and compliance gaps that can delay onboarding or create legal risks for the business.
